name: Game Of Chance
overview: Scripture reveals that reliance on chance or the pursuit of quick wealth is fraught with vanity and uncertainty, as seen in the warning against hastening to be rich and the dissatisfaction that comes from loving silver or abundance. While the casting of lots may appear random, Proverbs teaches that the outcome is ultimately governed by the Lord's sovereign will. True blessing and increase come through faithful labor rather than the uncertain gains of games of chance, reminding believers to trust God's providence rather than their own wisdom or luck.
